settings.text: Milled from a single block

content.label: h3: Milled from a single blo

settings.text: A milled putter is machined from one solid metal block for tighter tolerances and a more consistent face.
Each head is milled from a single billet of aluminum with steel components, worked by turning and milling without heating to preserve elasticity and strength.
3-position adjustable weighting
An adjustable weighting system lets you reposition the three head weights to match your stroke arc.
Move the three weights across three dedicated points; light and heavy options help compensate for stroke tendencies.
Interchangeable faces & necks
Interchangeable face inserts and necks let you tune feel, loft and alignment without changing putter.
Choose clubfaces from 1° to 3° and necks with different lie and offset for any green speed.
Our products
Choose your putter: Antares or Orion
Two milled putters, both €353: the Antares blade for feel and arc strokes, the Orion mallet for stability and higher forgiveness.

About us
Italian Craft, Brescia Engineering — Made in Italy, Game-Ready
GG Putters is a golf brand by GM PRODUCTION srl, born in a garage in the 1980s in the Oglio river valley near Brescia, Italy — a region with a centuries-old metalworking tradition.
Every putter is milled in-house from premium materials, turned and milled without heating to preserve the metal's original elasticity and strength — a genuinely unique, fully customizable product.

settings.text: The GG Putters Fitter Kit

content.label: h2: The GG Putters Fitter Ki

settings.text: The Fitter Kit is a modular fitting system that lets professionals test every putter configuration with a client in a single session.
Handcrafted in Italy and fully modular — from head shape to insert, feel and balance — so each player leaves with a putter that is uniquely theirs.
Request the Fitter Kit
What's inside the Fitter Kit

• 2 heads — one Antares and one Orion
  • 3 lofts (1°, 2°, 3°)
  • Weights kit — 2 heavy and 2 light (bullet or flat)
  • Necks (lie and offset)
  • Screws and hex screwdriver

settings.text: Should I choose the Antares or the Orion?

content.label: h3: Should I choose the Anta

settings.text: Choose the Antares blade if you favour feel and an arc stroke; choose the Orion mallet for higher stability and forgiveness. Both are priced at €353.
Are GG Putters customizable?
Yes. You can adjust the three weights, swap clubfaces from 1° to 3°, and change necks (lie and offset) to match your stroke.
